items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: No, that's who went with us, Wade Whaley.

ctx.x: Before I went to Los Angeles, I think I was playing with, I think I was playing with, Buddy Petit, when I went to Los Angeles. I went to Los Angeles the year of 1919.

I remember Fass tells about going out there, that he helped organize the group here to go out. That's right. And I know he said he picked up some of the fellows were working out there at Walter Dacu's, maybe at the bungalow out near the lake. Must have been. You weren't in that band though, Walter and Mutt and Wade Whaley, you weren't working with them. No, that's who went with us, Wade Whaley.

items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: And then I left and went to Los Angeles, and I mean, Manuel Manetta, and Wade Will and Mutt Carey.

ctx.x: The way he went, I just remember now. So, uh, I played around with different fellas until, uh, 1919. And then I left and went to Los Angeles, and I mean, Manuel Manetta, and Wade Will and Mutt Carey.
They never did draft you, huh?
